origins.thfox.fox.name: Fox
origins.thfox.fox.description: Vulpes are known for their cunning. They hide in shadows, attack unexpectedly and strike at their enemies' weakest.
power.thfox.dash_pounce.name: §6§l§nPounce
power.thfox.dash_pounce.description: By sacrificing defence, pounce forward and boost your attack while falling down.
power.thfox.hunt_toggle.name: §6§l§nHunt
power.thfox.hunt_toggle.description: Hide yourself by crouching and enter a hunting phase after much preparation.
power.thfox.foxify_toggle.name: §6§l§nFoxify
power.thfox.foxify_toggle.description: Become a literal fox when sleeping, and be able to yoink a fox away on an adventure with you.
power.thfox.swift_sprint_speed.name: §a§nAgility
power.thfox.swift_sprint_speed.descripti: You have specialized limbs that enhance sprinting and jumping abilities, and you're more resilient to fall damage.
power.thfox.smol_size.name: §e§nSmol
power.thfox.smol_size.description: Being a fox, you're shorter and have less endurance. But monsters will have a harder time noticing you.
power.thfox.weak_shield.name: §c§nWeak
power.thfox.weak_shield.description: You were born with slender limbs, which restrict you from using shields and performing well in heavy armors.
power.thfox.foxiality_night_vision.name: §e§nFoxiality
power.thfox.foxiality_night_vision.descr: Embrace your fox nature and thrive.
power.thfox.fluffy_fire_vuln.name: §e§nFluffy
power.thfox.fluffy_fire_vuln.description: Shaggy fur provides excellent cold protection but is highly flammable.
power.thfox.shy_weakness.name: §c§nTimidity
power.thfox.shy_weakness.description: Survival instincts make you fear predators, death, crowds, and danger, but there are ways to conquer the fears.
power.thfox.food_berry_bonus.name: §e§nUnique Taste
power.thfox.food_berry_bonus.description: Your food preferences are heavily influenced by your nature.
power.thfox.hunger_exhaustion.name: §e§nFast-Paced
power.thfox.hunger_exhaustion.descriptio: Your small body has a fast metabolism, granting higher attack speed but requiring frequent large food intake.
power.thfox.sound_emote_sniff.name: §a§nFox Sound Pack
power.thfox.sound_emote_sniff.descriptio: In case it isn't obvious, foxes aren't players.
power.thfox.storage_bundle.name: §6§l§nMouth Pouch
power.thfox.storage_bundle.description: A bundle to store items. (Approximation of the Origins inventory pouch.)
power.thfox.force_sit.name: Reset Fox State
power.thfox.force_sit.description: Emergency reset of all fox entity states.
neoorigins.sleep_blocked.thfox.shade: Your fox instinct forces you to sleep under shades!
neoorigins.sleep_blocked.thfox.fear: You're too scared to fall asleep!
neoorigins.sleep_blocked.thfox.hunt: You're hunting! Don't slack it off!
death.attack.thfox.predator_bite.player: %1$s couldn't escape the claws and fangs of %2$s.
death.attack.thfox.foxie_bite.item: %1$s underestimated how feral %2$s with their %3$s can be in a fight.
death.attack.thfox.predator_bite.item: %1$s was eviscerated to an unrecognizable shape by a %3$s-wielding %2$s.
